messages:
Raj Patel: Pushed a kernel_selector tweak + microbatch heuristic at 04:13 UTC, rolling to prod. Watch p95/p99 on short-seq services.
infra-bot: deploy started · rollout id=rl-9f3b · image=serving-runtime:v3.15.0 · env=prod :rocket:
Olivia Chen: already seeing p99 tail creep on convo-service, p99 ~750ms (baseline ~220ms). p95 also up ~2x.
Mike Torres: grabbing a flamegraph now, but KV cache hit-rate looks odd in the last 10m.
Sara Li: how big was the config change? microbatch params?
Raj Patel: small change, basically enabled autokernel and tightened target_latency:
```
runtime:
  kernel_selector: autoselect
  kernel_selector_flags: prefer_fast_attention=true
  microbatch:
    target_latency_ms: 80
    max_batch_size: 32
```
Olivia Chen: perf dashboard: https://perf.internal/reports/rl-9f3b — tail spikes coincide with rollout increments.
Mike Torres: quick profiler output (aggregated):
```
95th: 120ms -> 250ms
99th: 220ms -> 760ms
KV_cache_hit: 94% -> 68%
avg_tokens_per_request: stable
```
Raj Patel: KV hit drop is red flag. kernel_selector now honors seq_len padding and model_shard in hash. that likely changed cache keys for a lot of requests.
Sara Li: if kernel change flips kernel per-request, cache key variance will destroy prefix/KV reuse. that explains the tail.
Olivia Chen: agreed. high tail caused by cache misses + fallback to generic kernel for some long-seq combos.
Mike Torres: logs showing lines like: `kernel=generic_kernel fallback=true duration=420ms model=redwood-7b seq=1024` repeatedly.
Raj Patel: quick mitigation options: 1) revert kernel_selector to v3.14 behavior, 2) relax microbatch target to 120ms, 3) hotfix to keep cache key semantics stable.
Olivia Chen: Ops + SRE prefer revert first to restore SLOs quickly.
Sara Li: starting rollback now.
deploy-bot: rollback commanded: kubectl rollout undo deployment/serving-runtime -n prod · initiating
infra-bot: rollback in progress · rollout id=rl-9f3b-undo
infra-bot: rollback complete · serving-runtime -> v3.14.2 (stable) · duration 2m18s
Raj Patel: post-rollback metrics: p95 back ~110ms, p99 ~260ms, KV_cache_hit ~92%.
Olivia Chen: great. p99 back under SLO but schedule a canary + bench for any kernel changes.
Mike Torres: I'll run synthetic workloads with varied seq_len/batch padding to replicate cache key changes.
Sara Li: filing issue to redesign kernel selection hashing to avoid invalidating KV cache unless explicitly required. tagging perf, runtime, ml infra.
Olivia Chen: filed issue #3258 · assignee: Raj Patel · priority: P0 · due: EOD tomorrow :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: thanks all for quick rollback. we'll rework selector and add unit tests around cache key stability before trying again.
Mike Torres: will attach flamegraphs and a small repro in #3258.
Sara Li: closing the incident for now, will keep monitoring next 2h.
infra-bot: alert cleared: latency SLO breach resolved · sources: convo-service
Raj Patel: follow-up: add k/v warmup step into canary pipeline so changes that alter cache keys are validated.
Olivia Chen: agreed — add to runbook. postmortem scheduled 48h.
